gen-nixie-one-gf-varela-round: Varela Round has a modern, friendly look, with rounded forms that open wide in the lowercase. Its best quality is how it lets Nixie One's retro, hairline-steady curves stand out as the heading.
gen-nixie-one-gf-varta: Varta opens every e and a wide and plain. Nixie One handles the nostalgic, pen-drawn showpiece lettering, while Varta quietly carries the contemporary text beneath it.
gen-nixie-one-gf-vazirmatn: Nixie One draws every stroke with one constant pen line, no thick and thin anywhere, so it looks retro and mechanical. Vazirmatn, a plain sans, handles the friendlier reading work.
gen-nixie-one-gf-wix-madefor-display: Retro and ribbon-thin, Nixie One has stroke ends that look cut from a single strip. And Wix Madefor Display follows with gently flared curves, giving the page a contemporary text voice under that nostalgic top line.
gen-nixie-one-gf-wix-madefor-text: Wix Madefor Text has easy open terminals and a professional, contemporary feel that reads smoothly. Nixie One sits above it with its retro, uniform curves.
gen-nixie-one-gf-ysabeau: Approachable and professional, with sweeping curves that never close up, this body text moves along smoothly. Ysabeau then sits under Nixie One, whose diagonals carry the same heft as its stems for a retro-tech headline.
gen-nixie-one-gf-ysabeau-infant: Ysabeau Infant reads in a contemporary, approachable way, its terminals pointing outward like a pair of tongs. But Nixie One brings a retro-tech ring of an o with one constant wall, so the heading and text feel clearly distinct.
gen-nixie-one-gf-ysabeau-office: Nostalgic in its heading, Nixie One has a drafting-pen outline quality, with one constant nib width throughout. Yet Ysabeau Office keeps every curved letter open-ended and modern, which is what makes the pair work.
gen-nixie-one-gf-ysabeau-sc: Ysabeau SC is a professional, modern plain sans whose c gapes visibly at any size. Nixie One earns its keep big and short, where its retro diagonals match the stems.
gen-nixie-one-gf-zalando-sans: Nixie One looks traced with a marker, all open curves and nostalgic retro-tech charm. But Zalando Sans, a sans-serif, adds an approachable open-ended finish to every curved letter beneath it.
